configDiff.serverSideMergeDescription: Treats the right file as an overlay applied to the left base — same semantics as niac config merge. Devices in the overlay with the same name REPLACE base entries; overlay-only devices are appended; base-only devices are kept. Useful when you want CLI-equivalent output without resolving each diff block manually.
